Riverton opened a new flood barrier on Tuesday after three years of construction. The 2.4-kilometer wall cost $18 million and is designed to protect 1,200 homes along the Gray River. Mayor Lina Ortiz said the barrier will be tested during a drill next month.
Riverton opened an $18 million, 2.4-kilometer flood barrier to protect 1,200 homes along the Gray River, with a test drill planned next month.

Harbor City voters approved Measure K by 58 percent to 42 percent. The measure raises $12 million annually for street repairs through a half-cent sales tax that begins January 1 and expires after eight years.

Summarize the following text:

A controlled experiment changes one independent variable while holding other relevant conditions constant. Researchers compare outcomes between treatment and control groups so differences can be attributed more confidently to the intervention, though poor randomization can still introduce bias.
Controlled experiments isolate an independent variable by comparing treatment and control groups, but weak randomization can still undermine causal conclusions.
